items.raw_excerpt: The DGS has published, for the first time, national guidelines for nutrition in daycares and social care settings for children up to the age of three, recommending varied meals, age-appropriate portion sizes and textures, and reduced levels of ultra-processed foods, sugar, and salt.

items.raw_excerpt: After approval through a NASA and CSA selection process, the food company based in Gull Lake will be supplying jerky for the four-person mission with a launch date of Oct. 1.

items.raw_excerpt: El desalojo de Maricarmen Abascal, de 87 años, de la casa en la que vivió por más de siete décadas se convirtió en un símbolo de la crisis de acceso a la vivienda en Madrid. Su caso dio nuevo impulso a la protesta que mantiene cerca de 200 carpas en la Puerta del Sol. Los manifestantes exigen al Gobierno español medidas para proteger a los inquilinos, entre ellas frenar las alzas de los arriendos y regular los alquileres de temporada y de habitaciones. En su despacho para El Diario de Cooperativ
items.summary_en: An 87-year-old woman was forced to leave her home after 70 years, which led to about 200 people camping in Madrid's Puerta del Sol. They are calling for rent controls and stronger tenant protections.
